value.rationale: For the natural irreducible return-edge counterpart of a birth chain, endpoint Markov stochasticity is exactly delimited by two algebraic thresholds. That resolves a concrete numerical-conservation gap: small step size is not automatically positivity safe; positivity is recovered and later lost. The cyclic topology changes the admissible range nontrivially and the exact classification can inform step selection.
